card.name: Gaps before numbers in enzyme and section references
card.fires_on: The small joining mark or space that sits right before a digit or enzyme number, such as the slash in CYP3A4/5, the space before a section number in parentheses, or 'and' and 'or' between enzyme or transporter names.

modes.label: Slash or link in enzyme names
modes.description: A slash, 'and' or 'or' joining enzyme or transporter names, just before the next name or number.

modes.description: A blank space before a digit, such as a section reference in parentheses or a number after 'beta'.
